items.description: Translation of police report Spanish to English (68 lines)
items.rationale: Translating documents for the claim is excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f); not a loss of property.
Working materials raised alongside a translation charge are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (Tudor Royal watch + cash)
items.rationale: Robbery under threat of a weapon falls under 2.3.1 and is covered away from home within the EUR 5,000 limit. The Tudor Royal (about EUR 3,500 new) is capped at the EUR 2,500 valuables per-item limit, and the cash (>EUR 800) at the EUR 500 means-of-payment limit, giving EUR 3,000. After the EUR 50 deductible this is EUR 2,950.
Carriage, dispatch and forwarding charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
